description: A lizard man warrior stands upright, shown full figure in three-quarter view facing right, seen from the party's eye level. Its head is green and scaly with a red frill or crest along the back of the skull. It wears a grey chain-mail shirt over a dark leather jerkin with pads at the shoulders, a pleated skirt of brown leather strips, and leather bindings crisscrossed up its shins. A round wooden shield, reddish brown, is raised on its left arm, and a long spear with a pale metal head is held level across its body, pointing right past the shield. The background is a plain teal field inside a thin brown frame. The light is even and the mood steady and watchful. Frame 1: the warrior stands on guard with the spear held level; this pose is held for a long moment. Frame 2: the spear jabs a short way forward and the arms shift with it, shown only briefly. The loop reads as a long guarded wait broken by a quick warning thrust.
title: Lizard man with spear and shield
